title: Python Django ORM Manual
content: Django models use an active record pattern. The objects.filter() method performs lazy evaluation against SQLite and PostgreSQL databases.

title: Spring Boot Java Framework
content: Spring Boot uses @RestController and @Autowired annotations for dependency injection. Entity models are mapped using Hibernate JPA.

title: Flutter & Dart Widget Architecture
content: Flutter uses a reactive widget tree where StatelessWidget and StatefulWidget manage state via setState() callbacks in the Dart runtime.

title: Kubernetes Container Orchestration
content: Kubernetes pods run containerized microservices managed by deployment manifests, service load balancers, and ingress controllers.

title: Ruby on Rails MVC Architecture
content: Rails routes requests from config/routes.rb to controllers inheriting from ApplicationController, rendering ERB views.

title: Angular TypeScript Framework
content: Angular components use @Component decorators with two-way data binding [()] and RxJS Observables for HTTP communication.
